### What's changed in 1.0.2
- **Fixed: "Couldn't open the IR blaster (Failed to create IOUSBHostInterface)".** Recent macOS releases block sandboxed apps from opening USB interfaces, even with the USB entitlement. MacIR now runs outside the App Sandbox (still with the hardened runtime), so it can open the blaster directly.
- Remotes saved by 1.0.0–1.0.1 are moved over automatically on first launch. If macOS asks whether MacIR may access data from other apps, click **Allow**: that's the old sandboxed copy of your library.
- When the blaster can't be opened, the error now shows the exact error codes. If another program has the blaster open, the error names it.
- The diagnostic report now shows which process owns any open connection to the blaster.
